cohort_summary: 10 amateur recreational parlay/SGP bettors ($5-$100 units, DK/FD/Fanatics/ESPN Bet, mostly phone, 30-60 min pre-first-pitch). The app's model reads, filters, Prob sort and WHY lines give a decent pool of candidate legs, but the cohort's core job — combine 3-6 legs, understand same-game correlation, know the combined probability/fair price and compare it to the book — is entirely unsupported: no parlay/slip builder, no joint or correlated probability, no sportsbook prices or implied %, single-market views, and stars that save players not legs. Home is live-first rather than a pregame 'best plays' list, and phone Predictions is a long dense scroll. Live users get pitch-level calls instead of rest-of-game SGP numbers. 0/10 fully succeeded; 7 partial, 3 failed.

personas.name: Marcus Delgado
personas.profile: Amateur, 29, warehouse supervisor in Columbus. $20 units, DraftKings only. Builds a nightly 3-leg SGP on one game, usually 1+ hit stacks + over.
personas.goal: Arrive ~40 min before TOR@CLE, find 3 hitters likely to get a hit plus the total and judge if DK's +450 SGP price is fair.
journey: Opens app on phone; Home leads with LIVE DECISIONS (Biggest swing, Top call now) for games he doesn't care about.
Scrolls past scorecard to UPCOMING, sees TOR@CLE pill: ML CLE 57%, TOT O 8.5 60%, READ Alonso 1+ HR 23%.
Taps Predictions, 1+ Hit, Filters → teams TOR,CLE, status upcoming: 18 rows; banner still says 'Live mode: in-progress games first'.
Picks Harper 77%, Alvarez 78%, Devers 73%; switches to Totals chip to recheck O8.5 60% (number lost from view).
Multiplies in his head ~0.77*0.78*0.73*0.60 ≈ 26% ≈ +280 fair, but doesn't know if same-game correlation makes it better or worse; no DK price in app to compare.
Opens DK, builds the slip manually; no way back to app to 'check' it.
personas.quote: It gave me good hitters, but I still had to do the parlay math myself and I've got no clue if the correlation helps me.

pain_points.title: No way to combine legs into a parlay and see combined probability / fair odds
pain_points.detail: The core job of this user (stack 3-6 legs) has no surface. They have to multiply percentages in their head or a calculator; no bet slip, no 'add leg' button, no fair parlay odds to compare with the book's payout.
pain_points.evidence: grep 'parlay|slip|combine' in frontend/ returns nothing; row expanded (02_rowopen) offers only 'Open game ›'
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add '+ Leg' on every prop row/starter line, a sticky bottom slip on phone showing legs, joint prob, fair American odds, and a field to enter the book's parlay price to show EV.

pain_points.title: No correlation info for same-game legs
pain_points.detail: SGP builders need to know that, e.g., Over 8.5 + two hitters 1+ H from the same lineup are positively correlated and a starter Ks over is negatively correlated with opposing hits. App treats every read in isolation, so naive multiplication is wrong and the user can't tell which combos books are over/under-pricing.
pain_points.evidence: Game detail (Open game ›) and Starters list show independent marginals only; no joint/conditional numbers anywhere
pain_points.suggested_fix: In the slip, compute joint probability from the sim (or a correlation matrix) and show 'correlated +/-' badges and 'joint vs naive' delta; add a 'stacks that pair well' panel per game.

pain_points.title: No sportsbook line, price or implied probability next to any prop
pain_points.detail: Every row shows model % and league %, never the DK/FD price. A rec parlay player cannot tell if the 77% hit read is already priced at -400 (no value) or -250 (value) without leaving the app.
pain_points.evidence: phone__pred: P(1+ HIT) 77% / league 65% / LIFT +12 pts, no price column; pitchhawk.js:22 'no odds are fetched'; copy.js:203 WAGERING_OVERRIDES only changes tabs/footer
pain_points.suggested_fix: Show best available price + implied % and 'edge vs book' per row when wagering is on; let user type in a price if feed missing.

pain_points.title: Can only view one market at a time; no cross-market 'best plays' list
pain_points.detail: Market chips (1+ Hit / 1+ HR / 1+ HRR / Win prob / Totals / Starters) are single-select, so building a mixed slip (ML + total + hitter + K prop) means flipping 4 tabs and remembering numbers.
pain_points.evidence: pitchhawk.js:864 PRED_MARKETS single pMarket; phone__pred chip row
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add an 'All markets / Top plays' view that mixes legs from every market for one game or the whole slate.

pain_points.suggested_fix: Live game 'rest of game props' table sortable, addable to slip with live joint probability.

pain_points.title: No way to combine legs into a parlay and see combined probability / fair odds
pain_points.detail: The core job of this user (stack 3-6 legs) has no surface. They have to multiply percentages in their head or a calculator; no bet slip, no 'add leg' button, no fair parlay odds to compare with the book's payout.
pain_points.evidence: grep 'parlay|slip|combine' in frontend/ returns nothing; row expanded (02_rowopen) offers only 'Open game ›'
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add '+ Leg' on every prop row/starter line, a sticky bottom slip on phone showing legs, joint prob, fair American odds, and a field to enter the book's parlay price to show EV.

pain_points.title: No correlation info for same-game legs
pain_points.detail: SGP builders need to know that, e.g., Over 8.5 + two hitters 1+ H from the same lineup are positively correlated and a starter Ks over is negatively correlated with opposing hits. App treats every read in isolation, so naive multiplication is wrong and the user can't tell which combos books are over/under-pricing.
pain_points.evidence: Game detail (Open game ›) and Starters list show independent marginals only; no joint/conditional numbers anywhere
pain_points.suggested_fix: In the slip, compute joint probability from the sim (or a correlation matrix) and show 'correlated +/-' badges and 'joint vs naive' delta; add a 'stacks that pair well' panel per game.

pain_points.title: Phone Predictions list is a very long scroll of dense cards
pain_points.detail: Live view on phone is a long single column; rest-of-game numbers are buried several screens down.
pain_points.evidence: phone__live.txt: REST OF GAME appears after NEXT PITCH, AT-BAT, VELO sections
pain_points.suggested_fix: Compact one-line row on phone (name, market, %, price, + Leg), group by game, sticky market/game chips.

delights: Score chips at top switch games quickly
Live win probability with opened/now delta is easy to read
